data.cultural_impact: The name Shuraym, while not as common as more popular Islamic names, is a name with a rich and admirable cultural significance. It derives from the Arabic language, where it translates to "a man of high morals and wisdom." In Islamic culture, such qualities are highly regarded, and a man named Shuraym is often seen as a paragon of virtue and strong moral character. This name may inspire its bearer, as well as those who hear it, to aspire to such qualities in their own lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Shuraym lies in its reminder of the Islamic values of moral integrity and wisdom. In Islamic teachings, wisdom is a blessing bestowed upon believers by God and is essential for navigating the complexities of life and living in accordance with divine guidance. The name Shuraym serves as a constant source of inspiration for its bearer to strive for moral excellence and to seek knowledge and wisdom through study and reflection. By carrying this name, one is reminded of the importance of living a virtuous life, guided by both inner wisdom and the teachings of Islam.

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari, Ibn Jahm al-Fihri. The History of al-Tabari, Volume XXIX: The Caliphate of al-Mansur, Part Two. The Foundation of Baghdad. Translated and annotated by James W. redington. New York: SUNY Press, 1990, p. 66-67.
historical_references.context: Shuraym ibn Harb was a powerful Arab chief who ruled over the region of Wasit in Iraq during the early Abbasid Caliphate. He was an ally of the Abbasid caliph Al-Mansur and was responsible for the construction of the city of Baghdad.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Asakir, Ishaq Ibrahim. The History of Damascus, Volumes XIV and XV. Translated and annotated by H. A. Darwish. Beirut: Dar El-Fikr, 1986, p. 223.
historical_references.context: Shuraym ibn al-Aswad was a prominent figure in the Shia uprising in Damascus led by Imam al-Zahir. He was a well-known debater and scholar, and was known for his commitment to the Shia cause. Despite his efforts, the uprising was ultimately suppressed by the Seljuq Turks.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shuraym is of ancient Islamic origin and holds significance in various aspects of Islamic culture. It is mentioned in Islamic history as the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). In Arabic language and literature, Shuraym is a common name and is used in various literary works. In the context of Islamic spirituality, it is used as a spiritual name or as the name of a Sufi order. Today, Shuraym is a popular name on social media platforms such as Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube. On Twitter, it is often used in conversations and debates related to Islamic history and culture. On Instagram, it is used as a hashtag to explore content related to Arabic language and literature, as well as Islamic spirituality. On YouTube, it is the name of various channels dedicated to Islamic spirituality, Sufi music, and Arabic language learning. Overall, the name Shuraym continues to be relevant in modern Islamic discourse and is a reflection of the richness and diversity of Islamic heritage.
